title: Second Chance module
description: A module's module.yaml: its id, its release and the versions that release provides, what it depends on, and the data it carries. docs/modules.md describes every field.

option.description: Whether it takes a value (value), none (flag) or may be given many times (repeated); and what its value is, where it isn't text.

count.description: How many: 1, 1...2, or 1... for any number from 1.

roles.description: What each is, in order; the last goes for every argument after it.

layer.description: suggested: it's expensive, so a layer after it is worth keeping.

may-ask.description: It may ask the person something as it runs, so no layer lock is held for it.

program.description: A module someone added: its program, a Mach-O in its folder (arm64 and x86_64), which carries out its instructions over the module protocol (docs/module-programs.md).

signals.description: The module's signals a step of it watches for when it names none, by option: { alive: alive }.

reads-data.description: The module's data tables its Swift reads, which go into its steps' keys.

id.description: A shipped module's is one name (wine); one someone adds is namespaced (someone/directx9).

release.description: Our fixes beneath its versions: counts up, and is never written in a Wrappfile. Changing anything in the module's folder means raising it.

native.description: The Swift implementation compiled into Second Chance this module's code is; only a shipped module may name one.

versions.description: What this release provides, as a bundle constrains it with @: an engine's own version (10.0_8), or a plain number of the module's own.

preview.description: Used only where a constraint names it.

package.description: An engine's: the downloads it is made from, and the hash of the tree preparing them gives (docs/modules.md#engine-packages).

prepared.description: EngineTree's hash of the prepared tree, which preparing must give.

id.description: What the module's Swift knows it as (wine, wineskin).

urls.description: Where to look, in order; the sha256 decides.

headers.description: Headers each request for it sends: a registry's anonymous sign-in (GitHub's package registry's Authorization: Bearer QQ==).

depends-on.description: Modules installed with it, with an optional constraint (wine@10).

allow-paths.description: Folders of its own its Wrappfile's stages and functions may read files from (assets/), each relative to its folder and ending in /: nothing is read for being beside it (docs/wrappfile.md#what-a-build-may-read).

signals.description: Files of SIGNAL blocks: what a step watches for while it runs, named <id>.<signal> (docs/wrappfile.md#signals).

stores.description: Files of STORE and LOCK lines, every stage and function of the module seeing the stores they declare (docs/wrappfile.md#stores).

data.description: Tables of the module's own, each a YAML file in its folder (or JSON, which YAML 1.2 reads too), read as ${data.<table>.<key>.<field>}.

retired.description: Data an earlier release had that only Second Chance's own code read, never a bundle, dropped without a new version.

assets.description: Files the module carries for builds, tests or the wrapp, in its folder.

runtime.description: What the wrapp does for a program this module runs, compiled into it by sc generate.

save-warning.description: Whether the save warning is shown before the program starts.

updates.description: The module's default updates, run after a bundle's for a wrapp whose copy of this module is behind this release. One with no build is done by the module's own Swift.

when-changed.description: It applies only when one of these data files differs from the one the old wrapp was built with.

build.description: What the module adds to a build: its instructions, the options it adds to the core's, its mount fields (docs/modules.md#what-a-module-declares). The checker and planner read these alone.

instructions.description: Its instructions, by name in upper case (KEEP-DISCS for WINE.KEEP-DISCS).

core-options.description: Options it adds to core instructions, by instruction, each written --<alias>.<option>.

mount-fields.description: Fields it adds to core mount types, by type, each written <alias>.<field>=….

watches.description: Watches it adds to WATCH, each written --<alias>.<watch> (--wine.busy).

path-types.description: The path types it handles, by name (wine for wine:C:/…): what a path of its may be, and the short form it claims in a stage that USEs it (docs/wrappfile.md#path-types).

short-form.description: A regular expression the whole path must match: the short form it claims, in its roles. A bare /… is always the core's.

provided-files.description: Files its Swift provides rather than its folder, named module:<id>:/<path>.

setup.description: The instructions USE plans in a tree that doesn't have the module yet, in order: each one of its instructions.

update-setup.description: What USE plans instead in an old app's tree (FROM ${input.previous}), which an earlier build set the module up in: setup unless given.
